memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Six branches extended from the sides of the lampstand - three on one side and three on the other. Three cups shaped like almond flowers with buds and blossoms were on one branch, three on the next branch and the same for all six branches extending from the lampstand." - Exod 37:18-19 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Six branches reaching outward, three on each side, every one carrying light.

Notice that no branch generated its own light or its own oil. Each drew from the central shaft. Cut a branch off and it would still look like a beautiful piece of gold — but it would burn nothing.

Jesus said it plainly: apart from me you can do nothing (John 15:5). Not a little. Nothing.

We forget this constantly. We attempt Christian living on stored spiritual resources — an old experience, a past season of closeness, the momentum of good habits — and wonder why the light dims. Connection is not optional.

Notice too the almond blossoms. Almond is the first tree to flower in that region, blooming while everything else is still bare. It is the tree of early awakening. Later, Aaron's almond staff would bud overnight as a sign of God's choosing (Num 17:8).

Light and new life, worked into the same object.

And Jesus said we are the light of the world, a town on a hill that cannot be hidden (Matt 5:14-16). Six branches spreading outward — light was never meant to stay in the centre.

Stay connected. Then shine outward.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Are you drawing daily from Christ, or running on old supplies?
2. Where has your light dimmed, and why?
3. Who around you needs the light you are carrying?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, I cannot burn on my own. Keep me connected to You, and let my life give light to others. Amen.
